title: Branch Network Optimization & Demand Forecasting
thesis: Snowflake combines AWS Location Service data with H3 geospatial indexing and ML.FORECAST to optimize Philippine bank branch networks — identifying underserved areas, predicting demand, and recommending optimal new branch locations

talking_points: 850 branches serving 4.2M customers — average branch generates ₱18M annual revenue.
124 branches underperforming (negative ROI) — 47 are consolidation candidates.
15 provinces identified with population > 500K but zero bank presence.
show: Point at 850 branches on national map
tabs.call_out: 15 provinces with 500K+ population and zero branches — massive opportunity

transition.line: Let's analyze where to expand and where to consolidate.

talking_points: H3 hexagonal analysis: 62% of Filipino population is within 5km of a bank branch.
ST_WITHIN analysis: competitor density — BDO has 3.2x our coverage in CALABARZON.
Expansion candidates ranked by: unbanked population × income level ÷ competitor density.
tabs.call_out: CALABARZON: 16M population, BDO has 3.2x our branches — close the gap

transition.line: The geospatial data shows where. ML.FORECAST tells us how much demand.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts: Pampanga branches will grow 14% in transactions next year.
ML.CLASSIFICATION scores 20 proposed locations — 16 predicted profitable within 2 years.
Digital-first branches: 40% lower operating cost with kiosk + video banker model.
show: Display viability scores for proposed branches
tabs.call_out: 16 of 20 proposed branches predicted profitable in 2 years

transition.line: Let the EVP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Conchita asks: 'What's the projected revenue for a branch in San Fernando, Pampanga?'
Cortex Analyst: ₱24M annual revenue projected based on catchment population and demand model.
Follow-up: 'What does BSP say about branch banking in rural areas?' — searches BSP reports.
show: Type: 'Projected revenue for San Fernando branch?'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL + geospatial analytics + BSP regulatory search

talking_points: Location Service → H3 aggregation → catchment analysis → ML.FORECAST → expansion scoring.
H3 + ST_WITHIN replace Amazon Location Service analytics and Redshift Spatial.
Philippine banking: 55M banked, 51M unbanked. This optimizes 850 branches to serve both.
tabs.call_out: H3 geospatial + ML forecasting — branch network optimization in SQL

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine banking.
